show: Mariana Cabaret, the Spanish musical at Espacio Alma in Madrid (Oct-Dec 2026, 80 minutes). Write the synopsis strictly from this official plot text published by the venue, adding nothing that is not in it: "Madrid, año 2032. Un golpe de Estado ha convertido el país en una sociedad dominada por la represión, donde la libertad parece haber quedado en el pasado. En medio de este escenario, Mariana, una joven artista de cabaret, se enamora de 'El Capitán', líder de un movimiento clandestino que lucha contra la dictadura, y acaba involucrándose en la resistencia. Cuando el Comodoro, máxima autoridad de la ciudad y obsesionado con Mariana, descubre el complot, la somete a un cruel chantaje: deberá elegir entre traicionar a los rebeldes y sus propios ideales o enfrentarse a las consecuencias. Abandonada finalmente por aquellos por quienes arriesgó todo, Mariana tendrá que afrontar sola su destino. Inspirado en la figura de Mariana Pineda y en el universo poético de Federico Garcia Lorca, Mariana Cabaret combina musica en directo, interpretacion, danza y la estetica del cabaret en una historia de amor, resistencia y libertad."
synopsis:
Mariana performs as a cabaret artist in Madrid in 2032, where a coup d’état has transformed the country into a society ruled by repression and freedom seems consigned to the past. Amid this bleak reality, she falls in love with El Capitán, the leader of a clandestine movement resisting the dictatorship. Drawn into his struggle, Mariana becomes involved with the rebels and risks her own safety in the fight against the regime.

Her position becomes increasingly dangerous when the Comodoro, the city’s highest authority, discovers the conspiracy. Obsessed with Mariana, he subjects her to a cruel blackmail: she must decide whether to betray the rebels and abandon her own ideals, or face the consequences of refusing him. The choice places her love, her commitment to the resistance, and her personal freedom under unbearable pressure.

Having risked everything for those around her, Mariana is ultimately abandoned by the very people for whom she has made such sacrifices. Left to confront what awaits her alone, she must face her destiny in a city where power seeks to control not only political opposition, but also love, loyalty, and the right to choose one’s own path.

Mariana Cabaret is a story of love tested by oppression and of resistance pursued at great personal cost. It centres on the struggle for freedom, the weight of betrayal, and one woman’s confrontation with the consequences of her convictions.

show: ¡Es Navidad!, the family Christmas musical by Dalpao Producciones at Teatro Salesianos Estrecho in Madrid (Dec 2026 - Jan 2027, 70 minutes). Write the synopsis strictly from this official plot text, adding nothing that is not in it: "¿Y si la Navidad no fuera una fecha... sino un lugar al que siempre podemos volver? Cuando el espiritu navideño comienza a desaparecer, un viaje inesperado de dos duendes llevara a pequeños y mayores fuera del polo norte a buscar al proximo sustituto de Santa. Alli deben descubrir si los sueños aun brillan, si la ilusion nunca se pierde y si cada sonrisa tiene el poder de hacer realidad los milagros. Deben encontrar un tesoro antes de Nochebuena. Entre personajes inolvidables, canciones emocionantes, grandes coreografias y una historia magica, ¡Es Navidad! invita a toda la familia a vivir una aventura llena de humor, emocion y fantasia, recordandonos que el mejor regalo no se encuentra bajo un arbol, sino en el corazon de quienes compartimos esta epoca tan especial."
synopsis:
As the Christmas spirit begins to fade, two duendes leave the Polo Norte on an unexpected journey. Their urgent task is to seek out the next replacement for Santa, venturing beyond the familiar world of Christmas in the hope of finding someone capable of carrying its magic forward. With Nochebuena drawing closer, their search becomes a race to find a treasure before the most special night of the year arrives.

Along the way, the duendes must discover whether dreams still shine and whether ilusión can ever truly be lost. Every encounter invites them to look for the small signs that Christmas remains alive: the possibility held in a smile, the hope that survives uncertainty, and the power of people to make miracles real. Surrounded by unforgettable characters, they travel through a magical adventure shaped by humour, emotion and fantasy, where songs, grand choreography and moments of wonder accompany their quest.

Their journey asks whether Navidad is merely a date on the calendar or a place to which people can always return. As they search for the treasure and for Santa’s successor, the duendes are reminded that its meaning cannot be contained in the Polo Norte alone. It lives wherever people continue to dream, hold on to ilusión and share joy with one another.

At its heart, the story celebrates Christmas as an enduring space of hope, imagination and shared feeling. It suggests that the greatest gift is not found beneath a tree, but in the hearts of those with whom this special season is shared.

show: Monstruos, el musical, the Mexican horror comedy musical by Tort Producciones at Teatro Telon de Asfalto in Mexico City (Oct-Nov 2026, 100 minutes). Write the synopsis strictly from this official plot text, adding nothing that is not in it and naming no monster that does not appear in it: "¿Que pasaria si todos los monstruos de la historia existieran y alguien quisiera acabar con ellos? El famoso y desequilibrado Dr. Jekyll ha logrado lo imposible: reunir en su tenebroso castillo a los monstruos mas legendarios de todos los tiempos. Con engaños, han llegado Dracula, Frankenstein, El Hombre Lobo, La Bruja, La Momia, La Llorona e Igor. Lo que ellos creen que sera una gran convencion de monstruos, es en realidad una trampa mortal. Jekyll planea exterminarlos para extraer su sangre y terminar la formula que lo convierte en Hyde. Ahora, estos enemigos de toda la vida tendran que olvidar sus diferencias, unir fuerzas y luchar juntos si quieren salvar su pellejo." Directed by David Tort.
synopsis:
Dr. Jekyll, famous and unbalanced, completes the impossible task of gathering history’s most legendary monsters inside his gloomy castle. Dracula, Frankenstein, El Hombre Lobo, La Bruja, La Momia, La Llorona and Igor arrive after being deceived into believing that they have been invited to an extraordinary convention of monsters. Although they come together beneath the same roof, they are lifelong enemies, divided by the distrust and differences that have long kept them apart.

Their supposed celebration soon reveals its true purpose. Jekyll has not brought the monsters to his castle out of admiration or curiosity, but to spring a deadly trap. He intends to exterminate them and extract their blood, using it to complete the formula that transforms him into Hyde. What appeared to be a grand gathering becomes a fight for survival, with every guest threatened by the doctor’s plan.

Faced with the danger surrounding them, Dracula, Frankenstein, El Hombre Lobo, La Bruja, La Momia, La Llorona and Igor must make a choice. Their old rivalries cannot protect them from Jekyll’s trap, and escaping it will require them to put aside the differences that have made them enemies. To save their own skins, they must join forces and fight together against the person who has brought them all into the castle.

At its heart, the story turns a meeting of legendary monsters into a struggle against deception, danger and extermination. It centres on the need to overcome hostility and unite when survival depends on cooperation.

show: Leyendas Mexicanas de Terror 2, the Day of the Dead musical by Tort Producciones at Teatro Telon de Asfalto in Mexico City (Oct-Nov 2026, 100 minutes). Write the synopsis strictly from this official plot text, adding nothing that is not in it and naming no legend that does not appear in it: "Espectaculo de terror narrado por catrinas y catrines aderezado con canciones populares del dia de muertos. Historias como La Llorona, La Planchada, o La Tamalera asesina, forman parte de los testimonios populares incluidos en Leyendas Mexicanas de Terror, una obra para todos los amantes de los musicales y las narraciones de espantos." Cast: Ady Salazar, Tony Batres, Fanny Vega and David Tort.
synopsis:
Catrinas and catrines step forward to recount tales of terror, their voices accompanied by popular songs of Día de Muertos. Within this spectacle of fright, they present testimonies drawn from Mexican popular storytelling, inviting the audience into a world where the dead, the fearful, and the unforgettable remain close at hand.

Among the stories brought into the performance is La Llorona, alongside La Planchada and La Tamalera asesina. Each belongs to the succession of frightening accounts assembled by the catrinas and catrines, who shape the evening through narration and song. The musical numbers associated with Día de Muertos do not interrupt the tales; instead, they form part of the atmosphere surrounding the stories and their telling.

The performance moves through these popular testimonies as a theatrical encounter with Mexican tales of fright. Catrinas and catrines serve as the figures who lead the audience through the spectacle, giving voice to stories whose terror is carried through narration as well as music. La Llorona, La Planchada, and La Tamalera asesina emerge as part of a wider collection of espantos, presented for those drawn to both musicals and frightening narratives.

At its heart, the show joins Día de Muertos music with stories of terror from popular tradition. Its central themes are death, fear, remembrance, and the pleasure of sharing a chilling tale through song and theatrical narration.
